# Any scope. Bayan is alive at the Yuan court and sits in the cabinet (the same test as Y4's oe_yv_bayan_in_power,
# written here so this line does not depend on the Y4 files).

}
# Any scope. The Yuan has fallen. F6 (Y2): the Yuan's branch secretariats were dissolved (global var oe_yp_dissolved) or
# oe_yp_yuan_fallen holds (gen_yuan_y3.py).
oe_yw_yuan_fallen = {
    OR = { has_global_variable = oe_yp_dissolved oe_yp_yuan_fallen = yes }
}

}

# Any scope. CHI already got an event this month from Y4 (its CHI pulse ran before the scheduler), from Y1 (scheduler id
# 10 runs before this line; Y1's pick counts only if Y1 fired this month: its counter oe_dbg_n_y1 moved since our last
# round, because Y1 keeps its last pick after its schedule closes) or from another Yuan line (oe_yuan_ev_m).
# This line then sends nothing this month, not even an event at its window end.
oe_yw_yuan_busy = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:CHI c:CHI = { has_variable = oe_yv_pick var:oe_yv_pick > 0 has_variable = oe_yv_m var:oe_yv_m = global_var:oe_yw_m } }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_y1_m global_var:oe_y1_m = global_var:oe_yw_m has_global_variable = oe_y1_pick OR = { global_var:oe_y1_pick = 1 global_var:oe_y1_pick = 4 global_var:oe_y1_pick = 5 } has_global_variable = oe_dbg_n_y1 global_var:oe_dbg_n_y1 > oe_yw_y1n_seen }
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_yuan_ev_m global_var:oe_yuan_ev_m = global_var:oe_yw_m }
    }
}

oe_yw_open_1 = {
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_st_1 }
    has_global_variable = oe_yw_m
    global_var:oe_yw_m >= 0
    global_var:oe_yw_m < 3
    oe_yw_can_1 = yes
}
oe_yw_due_1 = {
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_st_1 }
    has_global_variable = oe_yw_m

    oe_yw_can_1 = yes
}
oe_yw_lapse_1 = {
    NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_yw_st_1 }

        AND = {
            global_var:oe_yw_m >= 3

                global_var:oe_yw_m > oe_yw_cut_1
            }
        }
    }
}
